sloka: अथ वर्षसहस्रे तु दशमे दशमं शिरः ।छेत्तुकामे दशग्रीवे प्राप्तस्तत्र पितामहः ।। ७.१०.१२ ॥
transliteration: atha varṣasahasre tu daśame daśamaṁ śiraḥ ।chettukāme daśagrīve prāptastatra pitāmahaḥ ।। 7.10.12 ॥

translations.english: Then, in the tenth thousand-year period, as Dashagriva (Ravana) was about to cut off his tenth head, Lord Brahma arrived there.
